department: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
description: Application and related services for obtaining a driving licence.
eligibility: Applicant must satisfy the applicable age and licensing requirements for the vehicle category.
Applicant must complete the applicable learner/driving test requirements.
required_documents: Form 1 self-declaration of physical fitness where applicable
Parent/guardian declaration for minor applicants where applicable
procedure: Apply through the applicable Parivahan/Sarathi service.
Licence is issued after successful completion of requirements.

department: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
description: Registration of a motor vehicle with the registering authority.
eligibility: Vehicle owner must apply to the registering authority having jurisdiction.
procedure: Submit the registration application to the appropriate registering authority.
Pay applicable registration fee and taxes.

department: Revenue Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
description: Issuance of an official certificate showing the applicant's income.
eligibility: Applicant must be an Indian citizen.
Applicant must be a permanent resident of NCT of Delhi.
required_documents: Family income proof such as salary slips where applicable
fee: Verify current fee on the official portal
processing_time: Verify current processing time on the official portal

department: Revenue Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
description: Certificate establishing domicile/residence status in Delhi.
eligibility: Applicant must be an Indian citizen.
Applicant must have continuously resided in NCT of Delhi for the last three years.
required_documents: Proof of continuous residence in Delhi for the last three years
fee: Verify current fee on the official portal
processing_time: Verify current processing time on the official portal

department: Revenue Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
description: Issuance of an SC caste certificate in Delhi.
eligibility: Applicant must be an Indian citizen.
Applicant must belong to a caste included in the applicable Scheduled Castes orders.
required_documents: Caste certificate of paternal relative where applicable
Proof of relationship with the certificate holder where applicable
Birth certificate or educational/residence evidence where applicable
procedure: Submit the applicable caste and identity/residence documents.
fee: Verify current fee on the official portal
processing_time: Verify current processing time on the official portal
